title: Sock pattern template
description: Reusable Markdown template for writing and sharing knit or crochet sock patterns with sections for sizing, gauge, materials, and step-by-step directions for cuff, heel, and toe

Use this reusable template to write and share your knit or crochet sock patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for toe-up or cuff-down constructions.
